title: Pool Boiling Performance Comparison of Smooth and Sintered Copper Surfaces with and Without Carbon Nanotubes
reason: The authors measured their own pool boiling curves, incipience superheats, and CHF values for HFE-7300 and DI water on four fabricated copper surfaces, e.g., "Critical heat flux for HFE-7300 increased by more than 45% for the hybrid surface relative to the smooth copper surface."
